Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the metadata from the PBS webpage. The metadata description clearly stated: "Ingmar Bergman, a titan of modern cinema, died Monday in his home on the island of **Fårö**, Sweden." However, the Planner erroneously claimed the text indicated "Faro, Portugal," confusing the Swedish island "Fårö" with the Portuguese city "Faro." This hallucination led the Planner to incorrectly direct the WebSurfer to verify a false location (Faro, Portugal) instead of the correct one (Fårö, Sweden), delaying the confirmation of the correct answer.
